Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.result

Class TimingData

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.result.TimingData
public class TimingData extends Object
Manages timing information for action execution. Tracks start time, end time, duration, and optional time segments.

This class encapsulates all timing-related functionality that was previously embedded in ActionResult.

Since:
2.0
